questionText: [Set 39.4] The preservation of the Great Stupa at Sanchi from being dismantled and shipped to European museums was largely due to:

options.text: Direct personal intervention and physical occupation by Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Total abandonment and complete geographical isolation in the Thar desert
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A royal decree from the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb declaring it an imperial sanctuary
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: The Begums of Bhopal (Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum) funding preservation and museum construction on-site
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Sanchi Stupa and Buddhist Architecture.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for History of Buddhism and Jainism (Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings) (Sanchi Stupa and Buddhist Architecture):
The Begums of Bhopal (Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum) funding preservation and museum construction on-site

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 History (Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings - Sanchi Stupa and Buddhist Architecture):
Rulers of Bhopal, Nawab Shahjehan Begum and her successor Sultan Jehan Begum, provided financial grants to preserve the stupa, funded plaster-cast replicas for European museums, and built a museum and guest house where John Marshall lived and worked.

Hence, Option (B)

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
